description: Supplemental multiblock build metadata for recipe-tree structure branches. Entries use exact, standard, or lower-bound GTCEu structure costs instead of controller-only scaffolds.

structures.name: Active Transformer Multiblock Lower-Bound Build
structures.description: Minimum fixed structure costs from GTCEu's multiblock pattern. Configurable hatches, buses, and ability blocks can replace some casing positions.
notes: The fixed casing/special-block counts come from the GTCEu pattern; buses, hatches, maintenance, mufflers, and parallel hatches may replace casing slots where the pattern permits.
Use the in-game multiblock preview for final hatch placement and optional upgrades.
Remaining X positions are configurable transformer hatch slots.

structures.name: Alloy Blast Smelter Multiblock Standard Build

structures.name: Assembly Line Multiblock Lower-Bound Build

Fluid input hatches can replace solid casing in the F positions when recipes need fluids.
